data.long_meaning: The name Athin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prana' which means breath, life. In Hindu mythology, the god of breath and life is Prana Deva. The name Athin is believed to bring vitality and longevity to the one who carries it. The name Athin carries the meaning “Breath, Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Athin usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
